svg.aria-label: Janat Yasser. I build machine-learning systems, then check whether their numbers hold up on data they've never seen. Figure: on HAM10000, a model validated on a leaky image-level split scored 0.853 on validation and 0.716 on the official test set (mean of three seeds); split by lesion, 0.779 and 0.731.

svg.text: I build machine-learning systems, then check
whether their numbers hold up on data they've never seen.
Fig. 1. HAM10000 skin lesions. With photos of the same mole on both sides
of the split, validation flattered the model by 13.7 points (3 seeds).
The official test set didn't. Split by lesion, the drop was 4.8.
FIG. 1 BALANCED ACCURACY, TWO SPLITS, 3 SEEDS
